fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. PR #657's CI (run 44423965760, attempt 1) failed TestScripts/run-status at run-status.txtar:38: the poll at line 35 exits once bare `rhiza run status` reads 'running', but the live run's current step was still 'first', so '^- Current step: hold$' had no match. Reproduced deterministically by changing step first's run to 'sleep 0.5' in scratch. Polling for 'Current step: hold' alone is not enough: until the live run's journal exists, bare status falls back (latestRun in internal/api/run.go) to the earlier stopped run, also at hold, so line 37's 'running' then fails (reproduced). Requiring both 'running' and 'Current step: hold' in one status read passed twice under the same delay. Ruling: fix the script's poll, no quarantine, no Go change.
fields.title: run-status flake, autonomous plan
